decode.note: sample(): accel in g (raw x 0.000976), the gyro in centidegrees per second (raw x 70 x 100 // 1000, exact) and in degrees per second (fixed.to_float of it); rel 1e-6 for the f32 scaling

cases.name: present
cases.output: id 0x6C ok -- device present; setup failed AFTER detect (init / config / timing)

cases.name: chip_select_dead
cases.output: id reads 0x00 -- chip-select not asserting, or device unpowered

cases.name: miso_floating
cases.output: id reads 0xFF -- bus idle-high: no device driving MISO (absent / MISO miswired)

cases.name: crosswired
cases.output: id reads 0x6B, expected 0x6C -- wrong device on this bus/select (crosswired)

cases.name: absent
cases.output: no bus response -- device not acking (absent / unpowered / miswired)

diagnose.note: diagnose(): one WHO_AM_I byte; the verdict text

probe.note: probe(): the transcript and the step that failed ('who_am_i', 'sample'), null when it passed

setup.note: setup() on the i2c path over a scripted part: input whether INT1 is wired and the transcript; output ok

wake.note: run() with wait() answering the scripted irq_runs, INT1 wired or not (plan B counts both): after each wake, whether the INT line is called silent and whether the note fired (once, at the limit of 3 timed-out wakes in a row)
